name: log-scout-analyzer-workspace
description: Log Scout Analyzer - Workspace root with centralized build orchestration

scripts.preinstall: echo 🔧 Installing workspace dependencies... && npm --prefix vscode-extension install && npm --prefix zed-extension install
scripts.check: npm run check:lsp && npm run check:extension
scripts.build:lsp: cargo build --release --manifest-path lsp-server/Cargo.toml && node -e "const crypto=require('crypto'),fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');const src=path.join('target','release',process.platform==='win32'?'log-scout-lsp-server.exe':'log-scout-lsp-server');const dest=path.join('vscode-extension','bin',process.platform==='win32'?'log-scout-lsp-server-win.exe':process.platform==='darwin'?'log-scout-lsp-server-mac':'log-scout-lsp-server-linux');fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(dest),{recursive:true});fs.copyFileSync(src,dest);const stats=fs.statSync(dest);const hash=crypto.createHash('sha256').update(fs.readFileSync(dest)).digest('hex');const hashShort=hash.substring(0,16);if(stats.size<5000000){console.error('❌ ERROR: Binary too small ('+Math.round(stats.size/1024/1024)+'MB). Wrong package built!');process.exit(1);}console.log('✅ LSP binary copied to:',dest);console.log('   Size: '+(Math.round(stats.size/1024/1024))+'MB');console.log('   SHA256: '+hashShort+'...');"
scripts.build:extension: cd vscode-extension && npm run update:versions && node generate-build-info.js && npm run compile
scripts.build:zed: cd zed-extension && npm run update:versions && node generate-build-info.js && cargo build --release --target wasm32-wasip1
scripts.build:all: npm run build:lsp && npm run build:extension
scripts.build:zed:all: npm run build:lsp && npm run build:zed
scripts.track:post-build: npm run build:lsp && npm run track:binaries
scripts.version:increment: cd vscode-extension && node increment-version.js && cd ../zed-extension && node increment-version.js
scripts.package: npm run version:increment && npm run build:all && npm run track:binaries && cd vscode-extension && vsce package --allow-star-activation
scripts.package:zed: npm run version:increment && npm run build:zed:all && cd zed-extension && node package-extension.js
scripts.clean: npm run clean:lsp && npm run clean:extension && npm run clean:zed
scripts.clean:extension: cd vscode-extension && if exist out rmdir /s /q out && if exist logs rmdir /s /q logs && if exist node_modules rmdir /s /q node_modules
scripts.dev:setup: npm install && cd vscode-extension && npm install && cd ../zed-extension && npm install
scripts.dev:reset: npm run clean && npm run dev:setup
scripts.postinstall: echo ✅ Workspace setup complete! Run 'npm run build:all' to build everything.

author: Log Scout Team
